account_anonymous_body: Sign in to manage your profile, sessions, and security.
account_signed_in_body: Manage your profile, sessions, and security.
account_devices_description: Where you're signed in. Signing out a device ends all of its sessions.
account_passkeys_description: Sign in without a password using a passkey.
account_passkeys_unsupported: Passkeys aren't supported on this device.
account_generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account_delete_description: Deletion is immediate, with no grace period. Your account data leaves the live database and every session ends. Audit and moderation records, the deletion record and data under a legal hold are kept. Backups keep copies for up to 30 days. Authored posts and uploaded media are not removed.
account_delete_export_hint: Export first if you want a copy. The file holds bookmarks, folders, reading threads, notes, home cards and settings.
account_delete_mismatch: Type the email on this account to confirm.
account_delete_fresh_auth: Confirm your identity in Security confirmation above, then delete again.
account_age_description: If you are under 18, this turns off comments, reading analytics and device features on this account. Your date of birth is used once to decide this and is not kept. You can answer once, and the answer cannot be changed here.
account_age_invalid: Enter a valid date of birth.
account_age_already: Your age is already recorded for this account.
